cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You raised your auction paddle so decisively that I raised mine. You'll agree the wardrobe I just bought is a good choice?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was scratching my ear. You've spent our sofa money.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. An opening move on storage. You'll agree it will be useful in the bedroom?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We needed somewhere to sit, not somewhere to put clothes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Put the clothes from our chairs into it. Can we call the seating problem solved and keep the wardrobe?

reason: Remove the unexplained auction of a delivery charge; B now questions the ordinary purchase and A converts that specific seating objection into retroactive approval.
